content:
Madonna made a stunning appearance at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, returning as the ceremony's opening performer for the first time in 23 years.

The 68-year-old singer, best known for "Confessions II," now marks her fifth time performing at the VMAs — a record in itself.

During Sunday night's performance, she brought out Charli xcx, Sabrina Carpenter, Sombr (Aaron), and longtime friend Debi Mazar. Madonna also called on Andrew Watt, Seth Rogen (yes, really!), and Julia Garner, who was once tapped to portray the pop icon in a now-shelved biopic.

Fans on X were left stunned by some of the guests, especially seeing Rogen — barely believing their eyes:

Madonna's most iconic opening performance came in 2003, when she shared the stage with Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera.

Madonna earned a staggering 11 nominations at this year's VMAs, including Artist of the Year, Song of the Year, and Video of the Year.

Taylor Swift follows closely behind with nine nominations, including a nod for the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honor.

MTV described the award in a press release as "a brand-new honor celebrating the visionary musicians who unleash creativity behind the camera, push the boundaries of what's possible in music videos, and elevate the art of visual storytelling."
